note: Versions read on the reference Mac (plan G7) on verified_on. Keys are the tool names of courselib.syllabus.TOOL_NAMES. 'command' prints the version; 'pattern' (a Python regular expression, searched line by line) captures it. Optional 'installed_in' names the lesson that installs a tool the learner does not have yet: until that lesson is done, fresh reports it as not installed yet instead of as a problem. Optional 'note' says where a version came from. 'fresh' compares installed versions with 'version'; for a tool whose major number is 0 the first two numbers count as the major version (0.13 -> 0.14 is a major change). Refresh this file only together with a re-verification of the affected lessons.
